title: PersonaTeaming: Exploring How Introducing Personas Can Improve Automated AI Red-Teaming

bias_targets.methodology: The paper does not evaluate a single specific demographic bias, but rather measures the vulnerability of LLMs to general harmful behaviors and safety violations (including "inciting or abetting discrimination"). It does this by measuring the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of adversarial prompt mutations generated by automated personas (Expert Red-Teamers and Regular AI Users) using seed prompts from HarmBench.
